title: Composition-RL: Compose Your Verifiable Prompts for Reinforcement Learning of Large Language Models
authors_zh: Xin Xu, Clive Bai, Kai Yang, Tianhao Chen, Yangkun Chen, Weijie Liu, Hao Chen, Yang Wang, Saiyong Yang, Can Yang
paper_type_zh: 可程序化验证的推理数据或基准
best_for_zh: 需要可复现结果验证的推理数据研究者。
one_line: One-sentence position:** Composition-RL turns saturated easy verifiable prompts into 1.323M harder composed tasks that restore RL signal.
Composition-RL 将已饱和的可验证简单题组合成 132.3 万更难 prompt，继续提供 RL 信号。
why: It exposes a reproducible terminal outcome check rather than only a textual reference.
inclusion_reason: The released resource exposes a reusable programmatic outcome-verification surface.

title: Problem
问题
html:
As models approach saturation on single-problem RL data, many prompts reach pass rate one and provide almost no learning signal. Finding new difficult human-written problems is expensive, and their answers or verifiers may be unreliable. Simply discarding easy prompts wastes existing verifiable resources.

Composition-RL combines multiple already verifiable problems into longer and harder within-domain or cross-domain tasks, constructs deterministic composite verifiers from sub-answer contracts, and increases composition depth through a curriculum to restore RL signal.

随着模型在单题 RL 数据上接近满分，大量 prompt 的 pass rate 变为 1，继续采样几乎没有学习信号；直接寻找更难人工题成本高，且新题的答案和 verifier 未必可靠。简单丢弃容易题还会浪费已有可验证资源。

Composition-RL 将多个已可验证的简单问题组合成更长、更难的同域或跨域任务，按子题答案构造确定性组合 verifier，并用课程逐步增加组合深度，重新激活 RL 信号。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The official Polaris-Composition-1323K release contains about 1.323 million composed verifiable prompts. Each record combines source subproblems, a composition instruction, reference answers for each component, and a jointly judgeable output format. Final reward requires all subanswers to be returned under the contract and checked by their respective rules. The dataset automatically expands saturated prompt pools; its key artifacts are prompt composition and verifier composition, while model training demonstrates that the new prompts restore gradients.

官方 Polaris-Composition-1323K 含约 132.3 万条组合式可验证 prompt。单条记录由若干原始子题、组合指令、各子题参考答案和可判定的联合输出格式组成；最终 reward 要求模型按约定返回全部子答案，并由对应规则逐项核验。数据可从已饱和题库自动扩展，重点是 prompt composition 与 verifier composition，模型训练只用于证明这些新提示能继续提供梯度。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Identify saturated prompts: Run the current policy multiple times and select source problems with near-one pass rates, low standalone learning value, and reliable verifiers.
  1. Compose prompts: Sample multiple subproblems within one domain or across mathematics, logic, and related domains, then create a unified instruction and explicit multi-part output format.
  1. Compose verifiers: Preserve each subproblem’s reference answer and checker, parse the model output, and judge components individually; reward is issued only when all or the specified aggregate conditions hold.
  1. Apply curriculum RL: Begin with fewer subproblems, increase composition depth and cross-domain complexity as the policy improves, and update sampling according to success rates.

1. 识别饱和题： 用当前策略多次 rollout，选择 pass rate 接近 1、单独训练价值低但 verifier 可靠的原始问题。
  1. 组合 prompt： 在同一领域或跨数学、逻辑等领域抽取多个子题，生成统一指令和明确的分项输出格式。
  1. 组合 verifier： 保留每个子题的参考答案与检查规则，解析模型输出并逐项判断；全部满足或按设定聚合后才给奖励。
  1. 课程式 RL： 从较少子题开始，随模型能力提高增加组合数量和跨域程度，并持续根据成功率更新采样。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper reports consistent gains across models from 4B to 30B, with curriculum increases in composition depth outperforming fixed difficulty and cross-domain compositions improving unseen-task transfer. The main controlled comparison keeps source problems and verifiers fixed and changes only composition, directly supporting reuse of saturated data. The boundary is that composed prompts are longer and cost more compute, so gains are not directly equivalent to using new hard questions under a token-matched budget.
论文在 4B 至 30B 多种模型上报告组合数据带来一致提升，课程式增加子题数优于固定难度，跨域组合还能改善未见任务泛化。关键受控比较保持原始题目和 verifier 不变，只改变组合方式，因此较能支持“重新利用饱和数据”的主张。边界是组合 prompt 更长、训练计算更多，收益不能与等 token 预算下的新困难题直接等同。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier difficulty scaling regenerates questions, changes numerical values, or asks strong teachers for harder tasks. Composition-RL preserves subproblem semantics and composes existing verifiable tasks at the prompt and verifier levels, increasing depth according to policy saturation. The novelty is composition as a scalable RL-data generation operation rather than a new optimizer.
已有难度扩展通常重新生成题目、修改数字或依赖强教师出难题。Composition-RL 不改变子题语义，而是在 prompt 和 verifier 层组合现有可验证任务，并根据策略饱和程度动态提升深度。新意是把组合本身作为可扩展 RL 数据生成操作，而不是新的优化器。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Limited naturalness: Artificially concatenated tasks may not resemble real work, and models may learn formatting and context management rather than deeper single-problem reasoning.
  1. Length and credit assignment: Deeper compositions increase token cost and failure probability, while all-or-nothing reward does not reveal which subproblem failed.
  1. Inherited verifier flaws: Any incorrect reference or checker loophole in a component propagates into composed tasks and may be exploited systematically.

1. 自然性不足： 人为拼接的多题 prompt 可能不像真实任务，模型学到的是格式管理和上下文记忆，而非更深单题推理。
  1. 长度与信用分配： 组合越深，输入输出 token 和失败概率越高；全对奖励无法告诉模型哪一子题出错。
  1. verifier 继承： 任何子题答案或 checker 的漏洞都会传播到组合任务，并可能被模型系统利用。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Revive saturated data: Compose near-one-pass-rate prompts at depths 2, 4, and 8 with unchanged verifiers and compare learning under equal rollout and token budgets.
  1. Cross-domain curricula: Compose mathematics, logic, and structured tasks, gradually increase depth, and report domain skill, formatting errors, and all-correct rate separately.
  1. Composite-verifier auditing: Test each component checker and output parser independently. Replace all-or-nothing reward with component scores when partial credit is needed.

1. 复活饱和数据： 对 pass rate 接近 1 的题按 2、4、8 子题组合，保持原 verifier，比较等 rollout 与等 token 的学习效率。
  1. 跨域课程： 组合数学、逻辑和结构化任务，逐步增加深度，并分别报告单域能力、格式错误和全对率。
  1. 组合 verifier 审计： 先独立测试每个子 checker 和输出 parser；若任务需要部分信用，可将全对 reward 改为分项得分。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: Composition-RL turns saturated easy verifiable prompts into 1.323M harder composed tasks that restore RL signal.
  1. Method hook: It selects prompts by pass rate, composes instructions and output formats, reuses component verifiers, and increases depth through a curriculum.
  1. Data hook: Polaris-Composition-1323K centers on subproblems, subanswers, composed prompts, and a joint parsing contract.
  1. Evidence anchor: Models from 4B to 30B benefit consistently, and curriculum and cross-domain composition help, but token and formatting difficulty also grow.
  1. Reuse decision: It fits recycling saturated RL data. Test every checker and parser and include token-matched baselines.

1. 一句话定位： Composition-RL 将已饱和的可验证简单题组合成 132.3 万更难 prompt，继续提供 RL 信号。
  1. 方法抓手： 按 pass rate 选简单题，组合指令和输出格式，逐项复用 verifier，并课程式增加子题数。
  1. 数据抓手： Polaris-Composition-1323K 约 132.3 万条，核心字段是子题、子答案、组合 prompt 与联合解析契约。
  1. 证据锚点： 4B–30B 模型一致获益，课程与跨域组合有效；但组合增加 token 和格式难度。
  1. 复用决定： 适合回收饱和 RL 数据；使用前测每个 checker、parser 和等 token 基线。
